responsibility: Provides the C++-specific bridge from cp trees to generic/GIMPLE form. It genericizes front-end-only statement nodes such as TRY_BLOCK, HANDLER, EH_SPEC_BLOCK, IF_STMT, and EXPR_STMT into generic trees understood by the middle end, participates in gimplification of OpenMP constructs, folds or rewrites C++ builtins and AST forms that need lowering, and handles C++-specific generated objects such as __builtin_source_location backing variables before middle-end passes run.
